text:
maya: Heads-up — I opened a docs PR for the Starter CLI + Docker quickloop refresh. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1298
liam: Thanks — sending a quick skim. what are the main divergence points?
maya: Mostly: command names (rw start vs rw dev), token setup examples (env vs credential-helper), and a couple of copy-paste snippets that still use old SDK param names.
liam: Got it. can you paste the failing snippet output?
maya: Sure — CI snippet test logs show this error:
```
SnippetTest: /docs/quickstart/starter/docker.md:42 -> NameError: client not defined
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "snippet_runner.py", line 87, in <module>
    main()
NameError: name 'client' is not defined
```
maya: The docs use `client` in JS examples but our SDK renamed it to `clientConfig` in v8.
docs-bot: Snippet tests: 3 failures, 1 warning. Failing files:
- /docs/quickstart/starter/docker.md
- /docs/quickstart/starter/local-dev.md
- /docs/quickstart/starter/auth.md
deploy-bot: Preview site built: https://staging-redwood-docs.example/preview/1298 (takes ~30s to warm) :rocket:
vera: I'll take Python snippets and the Dockerfile section. tagging @maya for context.
samir: I'll patch the JS snippets — quick find/replace for `client` -> `clientConfig` then run snippet-lint locally: `yarn run snippet-lint ./docs/quickstart/starter`
liam: Also double-check the auth flow: we switched to recommended tokenless dev mode in the CLI (DEV_TOKEN env var deprecated). any references to DEV_TOKEN should be updated.
maya: Good catch — I left one reference in local-dev.md that uses `export DEV_TOKEN=...` — will update to `rw auth dev-login` flow and add a note about credential helper for Docker (bind-mount ~/.redwood/creds).
vera: For Docker section, let's add a short troubleshooting block: 'If container can't read host creds, run `docker run -v ~/.redwood/creds:/root/.redwood/creds`'
samir: I'm noticing a broken link in auth.md to the onboarding sample repo (404). PR includes a link update but I want someone to sanity-check the sample app path.
liam: @maya can you confirm sample-app is at github.com/redwood-inference/sample-starter (was moved last month)?
maya: Yes — sample moved to `sample-starter` and path changed under /examples. PR updated but I missed one reference.
docs-bot: Reminder — please include a tiny test snippet for the Docker workflow that our snippet CI can run (exit 0). Suggested minimal test: `docker build -t redwood-starter . && docker run --rm redwood-starter --help`
samir: Patch incoming in a minute. I'll also add a note in the migration guide: "SDK v7->v8: param rename client -> clientConfig" so future readers don't trip.
vera: I'll push Python fixes now. ping me when preview site is ready so I can eyeball formatting.
maya: Preview link posted above — I pushed a small formatting tweak to the PR head a few mins ago.
deploy-bot: Preview site updated: https://staging-redwood-docs.example/preview/1298 (updated at 3321004380)
liam: Quick checklist before merge:
- [ ] fix all snippet CI failures
- [ ] update auth flow + credential-helper note
- [ ] correct sample-app links
- [ ] add minimal Docker snippet test
- [ ] add migration note for client -> clientConfig
maya: I'll rebase and address the checklist. can we aim to merge before EOD? small change set.
samir: I can review and approve once JS snippets are patched.
vera: I'll approve Python docs after preview check.
docs-bot: FYI — automerge is disabled for docs PRs touching quickstart; manual merge only.
maya: Cool — assigning reviewers: @samir, @vera, @liam. merging plan: fast-forward to main, then cherry-pick to stable branch (release freeze tomorrow).
liam: If stable needs a hotfix, add a short changelog note under /releases/notes.
maya: Will do. thanks all :pray:
samir: Patch merged to PR branch, running snippet tests locally now.
docs-bot: Snippet tests: 0 failures on head branch.
maya: Great — I'll merge after @liam final ack.
liam: acked. merging now. :shipit:
